customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print('updateStepCheck() called')

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	procedureStepCheckInfo = dict(self.view.custom.procedureStepCheckInfo)
	
#	checkConfig = system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.checkConfig)
#	pickListId = checkConfig['pickListInfo']['pickListId']
#	if pickListId:
#		pickListName = self.view.custom.config.pickLists[str(pickListId)].pickListName
#		pickListValues = checkConfig['pickListInfo']['pickListValues'][pickListName]
#		
#	procedureStepCheckInfo['checkConfig'] = {
#												'dataTypeId': checkConfig['dataTypeId'], 
#												'engUnitId': checkConfig['engUnitId'], 
#												'pickListId': pickListId, 
#												'pickListValues': pickListValues
#											}
	
	procedureStepCheckInfo['checkConfig'] = system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.checkConfig)
	procedureStepCheckId = procedureStepCheckInfo['procedureStepCheckId']
	procedureStepCheckInfo['checkName'] = procedureStepCheckInfo['checkName'] or None
	if procedureStepCheckId is None: 
		procedureStepCheckId, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.addProcedureStepCheck(procedureStepCheckInfo, userId)
		self.view.params.values.procedureStepCheckId = procedureStepCheckId
		system.perspective.print('addProcedureStepCheck() returned %s %s'%(procedureStepCheckId, msg))
	else:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureStepCheck(procedureStepCheckInfo, userId)
		system.perspective.print('updateProcedureStepCheck() returned %s %s'%(retVal, msg))
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.procedureStepCheckInfo")		
	
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Couldn't update this check. %s"%msg})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Check has been updated"})
	
#	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.checkConfig")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('stepCheckUpdated', {})
	
	return

system.perspective.print("pickListButton() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	pickListValues = self.view.custom.checkConfig.pickListInfo.pickListValues[payload['params']['txtType']][payload['params']['txtOption']]
	
	if payload['params']['txtValue'] is None and payload['text']: #This is new
		pickListValues.append(payload['text'])
	else:
		system.perspective.print("2")
		idx = pickListValues.index(payload['params']['txtValue'])
		system.perspective.print("idx %s"%idx)
		pickListValues.pop(idx)
		if payload['text']:
			system.perspective.print("inserting %s %s"%(idx,payload['text']))
			pickListValues.insert(idx, payload['text'])
			
	return
